title: Plan renderer-neutral frame adoption across KP surfaces
summary: Break down graph/vector panels, source-code traces, dashboard previews, and export previews so each consumes semantic frames from interpreters instead of owning semantic time.

sourceRefs.summary: Graph frame adapter path to broaden beyond current samples.
Source/programming frame adapter path for code trace rendering.
Dashboard asset preview field surface that should consume semantic frames.
Export frame-sequence artifact that should stay renderer-neutral.

expectedLearning: Which frame fields must become required across graph, source, dashboard, and export surfaces.
Which renderer-specific states can stay mutable view bindings.
Whether one adoption loop or several domain loops is the right execution shape.
allowedWork: Create a concrete breakdown for frame adoption by surface.
Name shared frame fields and law checks before implementation.
Keep graph and source renderers as consumers of sampled semantic frames.
disallowedWork: Do not replace WebGL, SVG, or code rendering internals before the frame boundary is explicit.
Do not create a separate timing system for graphs or source traces.
revisitWhen: After promoted transform definitions and motif laws are stable enough to serve as frame inputs.
